prs.title: Tie gRPC code-mode connection lifetime to live sessions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Tie gRPC code-mode connection lifetime to live sessions

## Why

Some hosts assign a worker per connection. Idle connection eviction can prevent a quiet session from reaching the worker holding its lease, while retaining a connection after the last session closes unnecessarily keeps that worker allocated.

## What changed

- Disable the HTTP connection pool idle timeout for gRPC code-mode connections.
- Cache URL-based clients weakly and let live sessions own the shared client, releasing their ownership on closure or failure even while the provider remains alive.
- Acquire clients for deferred RPCs only when needed and return the session error if the client has already been released.

## Testing

Add regression tests that verify connection reuse and stored state after 120 seconds of inactivity, and connection closure after the last shared session fails while the provider and session handles remain alive.

prs.title: Support multiple side chats in the TUI sidebar
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Support multiple side chats in the TUI sidebar

## What changed

- When side retention is enabled, let the sidebar chooser create additional side chats from the main chat or reopen existing ones.
- Add numbered, clickable tabs and keyboard navigation in the chooser. Keep the selected tab visible when space is limited.
- Preserve drafts, transcript history, and the sidebar layout when switching between sibling side chats.
- Make `/side` with a prompt request a new side chat, while `/side` without arguments reopens the selected side chat. Preserve existing reuse behavior when side retention is disabled.

## Testing

Extend TUI tests and snapshots to cover creating sibling side chats, switching through the chooser and tabs, retaining drafts and history, and restoring image attachments after failed creation.

prs.title: Decouple message lifecycle state from model-visible item IDs
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Decouple message lifecycle state from model-visible item IDs

## Why

A message's model-visible item ID may be unknown until the recipient records it. Message lifecycle observers need to capture publication state before that point.

## What changed

Remove `message_id` from `MessageLifecycleInput` and give each publication's `ExtensionData` a fresh UUID key. Stop assigning an item ID when publishing messages for lifecycle observers.

## Testing

Update the agent mailbox test to store a contributor-specific token in `ExtensionData` at publication and retrieve it at consumption, verifying that publication state survives queued delivery and recipient eviction.

prs.title: Support credential export commands for gateway authentication
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Support credential export commands for gateway authentication

## What changed

Allow `model_providers.<id>.gateway_oauth.credential_export` to supply a gateway access token instead of browser OAuth. Run the configured command on first use, cache its token in memory, and deliver it through the configured header or cookie. Export failures surface directly, and command-backed providers do not require an OAuth session.

Require mutually exclusive OAuth and exporter settings, same-origin model catalog access, and rejection of HTTP redirects for command-backed gateway credentials. Share the bounded, timeout-controlled command runner with AWS credential export.

## Testing

Add tests for inference and model listing without OAuth, token caching and recovery after invalid output, preservation of primary authentication, and rejection of mixed OAuth/exporter configuration.

prs.title: Render delegated thread messages as Markdown in the TUI
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Render delegated thread messages as Markdown in the TUI

## Why

Incoming delegated messages were rendered as plain text, leaving Markdown formatting visible and links without hyperlink metadata.

## What changed

Use a dedicated history cell to render the message body as Markdown while keeping the source task attribution literal. Preserve hyperlinks and wrapping, and apply the appropriate list spacing for scrollback and the redrawable transcript.

Use the same rendering for live messages, resumed history, and transcript projection.

## Testing

Extend replay coverage to check matching live and replayed output, transcript rendering, hyperlink destinations, and shared source text across wrapped rows. Add a snapshot covering list spacing in scrollback and the redrawable transcript.

prs.title: Centralize managed proxy preparation and sandbox routing
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Centralize managed proxy preparation and sandbox routing

## What changed

Move proxy configuration and routing selection into `prepare_managed_network`. Keep native Windows launches direct by stripping managed proxy variables before credential brokering, and select dedicated listeners only for Windows MXC launches.

Consolidate managed network context filtering in `SandboxManager` and simplify proxy preparation for Linux and MXC while preserving the macOS Seatbelt context.

## Testing

Add Windows regression coverage for native launches with both disabled and enabled proxy configurations, verifying that managed proxy variables are removed while caller environment values and API credentials are preserved.

prs.title: Support update-boundary paging across forked thread histories
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Support update-boundary paging across forked thread histories

## Why

Item reads with an update boundary previously rejected forked thread histories and only supported an exclusive lower bound on update ordinals.

## What changed

- Add `before_updated_at_ordinal` as an exclusive upper bound, mutually exclusive with `after_updated_at_ordinal`.
- Allow update-filtered and update-ordered item reads across parent and child segments, applying segment bounds and preserving cursor pagination in both directions.
- Require an update boundary for update-order sorting and reject either boundary when using an item anchor or item-ID filtering.

## Testing

Extend thread-store tests to cover upper-bound filtering, descending cursor pagination, forward and backward paging across forked lineages, mutually exclusive boundaries, and ordinals outside SQLite's integer range.

prs.title: Check extension budgets before model generation requests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Check extension budgets before model generation requests

## What changed

Add a default `ModelRequestContributor::budget_exhausted` hook and fail generation with `SessionBudgetExceeded` when any contributor reports an exhausted budget for the thread.

Check budgets before HTTP requests and before WebSocket connection setup, then check again after the connection is established. WebSocket warmup remains available when the budget is exhausted.

## Testing

Add coverage for budget changes during a tool call, verifying that exhaustion prevents the next model request while an available budget allows completion. Extend WebSocket coverage to verify that exhausted generation opens no connection and warmup still permits connection reuse once the budget becomes available.

prs.title: Support optional thread IDs in hosted file uploads
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Support optional thread IDs in hosted file uploads

## What changed

Add an optional `thread_id` to `HostedFileUploadContext` and include it as `codex_thread_id` in file creation requests when provided. Keep MCP app uploads without this field while retaining the thread ID in tool-call metadata.

## Testing

Extend upload tests to check inclusion and omission of `codex_thread_id`, and assert that MCP app calls retain `_meta.threadId` without adding it to file uploads.

prs.title: Pack relative relocations in x86-64 musl release builds
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Pack relative relocations in x86-64 musl release builds

## What changed

Add `-z pack-relative-relocs` to the Cargo and Bazel release linker flags for
`x86_64-unknown-linux-musl`, alongside the existing safe identical code folding.

prs.title: Retry gateway credential exports after unauthorized responses
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Retry gateway credential exports after unauthorized responses

## Why

Cached gateway command credentials need to be refreshed when the gateway rejects them with a `401`.

## What changed

Clear the cached `credential_export` token after an inference HTTP `401` or a WebSocket upgrade rejected with `401`, then rerun the command for one retry. Preserve subsequent primary authentication recovery if the retry is also unauthorized, and document the behavior.

## Testing

Add integration coverage for using a new exported token, reporting an invalid export, recovering primary authentication after the gateway retry, and stopping after a second unauthorized WebSocket upgrade.

prs.title: Handle TUI message submission receipts and preserve uncertain drafts
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Handle TUI message submission receipts and preserve uncertain drafts

## Why

The TUI's cached active turn can be stale when a cloud message is submitted. A lost reply also leaves delivery uncertain, so automatically resending the draft risks submitting it twice.

## What changed

- Let the cloud server choose whether an Enter submission starts or steers a turn, and apply its receipt to the matching client message ID.
- Keep Tab-queued input waiting until the admitted turn finishes, including before its start notification arrives.
- Restore rejected submissions to the composer. Hold duplicate or unconfirmed submissions out of automatic delivery until history confirms them.
- Reconcile saved drafts and pending steers by client message ID when resuming sessions, and preserve submissions belonging to other turns during interruption recovery.
- Classify cloud preflight failures as invalid parameters so rejected queued input can be restored safely.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for cloud receipt outcomes, queued-input ordering, rejected drafts, lost replies, interruption recovery, and session resume with identical message text but distinct client IDs.

prs.title: Allow provider selection for gateway OAuth reads and logins
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Allow provider selection for gateway OAuth reads and logins

## Why

Gateway OAuth reads and logins previously used only the current provider, preventing clients from authorizing another configured provider without changing the default.

## What changed

- Add optional `modelProvider` params to `account/gatewayOAuth/read` and `account/gatewayOAuth/login`, preserving current-provider behavior for omitted or null params and selectors.
- Validate explicit providers against current managed policy without changing the default or any thread's provider.
- Retain readiness state across providers and send `account/gatewayOAuth/changed` notifications for every configured provider sharing the changed credential.
- Update protocol schemas, TypeScript types, Python models, and documentation.

## Testing

Add coverage for non-default provider login, retained readiness when alternating providers, notifications for shared credentials without starting login, and legacy TypeScript request compatibility.

prs.title: Add device-code authorization for gateway OAuth
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add device-code authorization for gateway OAuth

## Why

Gateway sign-in needs an alternative for terminals that cannot open a browser.

## What changed

- Add optional `gateway_oauth.device_authorization_url` configuration and a `login_with_device_code` API that presents a verification URL and user code, polls for approval, and persists the resulting credentials.
- Use the configured proxy and network policy, validate verification URLs, and bound OAuth responses. Support cancellation and report denied or expired codes without exposing issuer error details.

## Testing

Add tests for successful authorization and credential persistence, unsafe verification URLs, network-policy denials, denied and expired codes, and cancellation during approval or credential storage.

prs.title: Bind runtime auth to the provider's selected credential source
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Bind runtime auth to the provider's selected credential source

## Why

Runtime authentication must use the credential selected by the model provider. Explicit API keys and command credentials need independent ownership so cached connections and in-flight work cannot cross credential sources.

## What changed

- Register and reuse runtimes per credential source, supporting explicit provider keys and command credentials without falling back to saved login credentials.
- Track `AuthOwner` by credential manager and owner generation across WebSocket state, compaction, and scoring.
- Preserve cached identity and runtime registration state during credential-source outages or failed storage reloads. Require a successful auth reload before logout revokes credentials.
- Reject requests whose production or staging environment differs from runtime registration, including model catalog requests.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for credential selection and runtime reuse, owner isolation, source outages, failed reloads and logout recovery, and environment mismatches.

prs.title: Enable resizing the sidebar chooser
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Enable resizing the sidebar chooser

## Why

Sidebar resizing previously required an open side chat, leaving the chooser without the same width controls.

## What changed

- Support keyboard resizing, width presets, and divider dragging for the sidebar chooser, with resize hints that fit narrow sidebars.
- Keep keyboard resize mode active across startup thread assignment and replacement of the chooser by a new side chat, so `Enter` finishes resizing without submitting the parent draft.
- Activate resize bindings only when a split is available, and prevent divider drags from starting while the split is animating.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for chooser resizing, width preservation when switching between the chooser and a chat, startup and side-chat creation transitions, draft preservation, and unavailable resize bindings in narrow terminals.

prs.title: Preserve client metadata through queued submissions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve client metadata through queued submissions

## Why

Queued inputs previously stored and dispatched without the submitting client's Responses API metadata, losing attribution such as `client_type` when the queued turn started.

## What changed

- Accept `responsesapiClientMetadata` when adding or updating queued submissions and expose it on returned queue items.
- Persist metadata with the input and forward it when starting a selected item or dispatching an idle queue, including after restoration.
- Preserve existing metadata when an update omits it or supplies an empty map; replace it when a non-empty map is supplied.
- Keep stored inputs readable by older queue workers and update generated protocol artifacts.

## Testing

Extend queue service and app-server tests to cover metadata round trips, preservation and replacement on edits, compatibility with older readers, and forwarding during selected, idle, and restored dispatch.

prs.title: Add a gated Cloud backend to the TUI
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add a gated Cloud backend to the TUI

## What changed

- Register an additional Cloud connection on supported macOS and Linux launches when `TuiMultiBackend` is enabled, using the selected ChatGPT account and local network policy.
- Preserve backend settings and identify Cloud in connection controls and status.
- Let Cloud supply the model when a thread opens, skip local skills requests and stale results, and allow resume without a local working-directory override.
- Preserve Git metadata in Cloud thread snapshots and continue history hydration past empty filtered pages within the scan budget.
- Report Cloud connection failures and require reopening Codex to reconnect.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for Cloud model bootstrap, skipped skills requests, resume directory handling, history pagination through filtered pages, and Git metadata preservation.

prs.title: Add opt-in incremental tools for regular OpenAI Responses
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add opt-in incremental tools for regular OpenAI Responses

## Why

Incremental tool declarations were limited to Responses Lite. Regular OpenAI Responses requests sent the full current tool catalog on each request.

## What changed

- Add the disabled-by-default `incremental_tools_legacy` feature for regular OpenAI Responses, independently of the Responses Lite `incremental_tools` flag.
- Support tool declarations and updates in conversation history, including during compaction, while preserving existing history prefixes.
- Keep hosted `web_search` configuration in top-level `tools` rather than `additional_tools`, including in compaction requests.

## Testing

Extend request-history scenarios and snapshots to cover regular Responses catalog updates, model switches, compaction, and MCP tool removal and restoration. Assert that incremental requests preserve input prefixes and keep web search out of history declarations.

prs.title: Carry targeted moderation decisions on final-answer messages
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Carry targeted moderation decisions on final-answer messages

## What changed

Read `final_answer_moderation` metadata and attach `moderation: { moderated: boolean }` to the completed final-answer message only when its item ID matches. Apply this in both normal and plan modes, and reset the pending decision when a new response starts.

Preserve the answer's native item ID and moderation flag through legacy events and history reconstruction. Combine text parts into one legacy event when a moderation decision is present.

Expose nullable moderation data on app-server agent messages and update the JSON schemas, TypeScript types, and Python models.

## Testing

Add an integration test for moderation on completed answers and their legacy events. Extend protocol conversion tests to cover populated moderation data and serialization as `null` when absent.

prs.title: Remove incomplete prereleases after asset upload failures
Bound REPL provenance costs in elastic context preparation
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Bound REPL provenance costs in elastic context preparation

## Why

A reviewer receiving retained REPL responses after compaction can exhaust its context budget on protected response headers alone when the store contains many small results.

## What changed

Select a contiguous suffix of the newest responses before allocating body budgets, bounding elastic selection by the token-derived cost of provenance headers and separators. Preserve retained response bodies and images for subsequent allocation, and include dropped responses in the omission count. Apply this selection to both text-only and multimodal evidence.

## Testing

Extend the elastic REPL regression test with 10,000 responses in both evidence modes, checking budget admission, contiguous newest-response retention, preserved text and images, and combined storage and selection omission counts.

prs.title: Recompute the approval reviewer when switching models
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Recompute the approval reviewer when switching models

## Why

Switching away from a model that requires automatic review should restore the user's requested approval reviewer instead of retaining the model's enforced reviewer.

## What changed

Recompute the reviewer from the requested preference and model requirements when the model changes without an explicit reviewer update, unless the session uses a trusted guardian reviewer. Preserve an explicit automatic-review preference across subsequent model switches.

## Testing

Extend the app-server settings regression test to cover restoring user review after leaving a protected model and retaining an explicit automatic-review choice across repeated model switches.

prs.title: Keep verified question/answer records whole under elastic budgets
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Keep verified question/answer records whole under elastic budgets

## Why

Truncating verified answers can obscure the association between questions and responses. Elastic entry caps must preserve that association.

## What changed

Mark verified answer records in root conversation and trusted user answer sections so elastic preparation keeps them intact when they fit. Replace oversized records with the protected incomplete-answer notice and record zero retained evidence bytes.

## Testing

Add a regression test with two questions and opposite answers, checking that both evidence sections omit oversized records whole and preserve complete records when the entry cap allows them.

prs.title: Delete incomplete prereleases by release ID
Validate implicit API keys for Guardian Decisions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Validate implicit API keys for Guardian Decisions

## Why

Decisions uses a commercial endpoint, so implicitly inherited credentials must exclude FedRAMP API keys.

## What changed

Reject empty, whitespace-padded, and FedRAMP keys selected from cached authentication or `OPENAI_API_KEY`, returning a credentials error without rewriting the key. Explicit `CODEX_GUARDIAN_DECISIONS_API_KEY` overrides retain their existing behavior.

## Testing

Extend the cached-key precedence test to verify that FedRAMP project and service-account keys, including a whitespace-padded key, are rejected even when `OPENAI_API_KEY` provides a fallback.

prs.title: Avoid full image decoding for original-detail context estimates
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Avoid full image decoding for original-detail context estimates

Read inline image dimensions with `ImageReader::into_dimensions` instead of
loading the full image into memory. Keep the existing patch-based estimate
and fallback when dimensions cannot be read.

prs.title: Scope file change approval cancellation to the requesting turn
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Scope file change approval cancellation to the requesting turn

## Why

A delayed file change approval cancellation could interrupt a later turn, even when the original approval was no longer pending.

## What changed

Send `Op::CancelPatchApproval` with the approval ID and requesting turn ID from the app server. Resolve cancellations only for a matching pending approval and interrupt its requesting turn only if it is still active. Route legacy `Op::PatchApproval` abort decisions through the same pending-approval handling.

## Testing

Add a regression test that cancels an approval, then replays that cancellation while a second turn has a pending approval with the same call ID. Verify that the second approval succeeds and its turn remains active.

prs.body:

prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add fixed read views for local message boards

## Why

Concurrent appends can shift live results between pages. Readers need a fixed catalog and post boundary to browse without including later activity.

## What changed

- Add `LocalAgentMessageBoard::read_view` and export `LocalBoardReadView`, exposing the captured channel catalog and a read-only board handle.
- Freeze channel summaries and apply a post sequence cutoff to searches, thread listings, reply summaries, and individual reads. Later appends are excluded even when backdated.
- Reject all mutations through fixed views, including subscription changes, while preserving live handle behavior.

Views share SQLite storage without holding a transaction open. They do not retain deleted posts.

## Testing

Add integration coverage for frozen catalogs and paginated reads, exclusion of newer and backdated appends, mutation denial, and continued live updates.

Fix authentication for git-attribution settings requests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix authentication for git-attribution settings requests

## Why

Git-attribution settings requests need to honor runtime authentication for their destination. Repeated authorization failures after a credential refresh must also let world-state contribution finish.

## What changed

- Use the thread's `ProviderAuthContext` credentials and runtime authentication when available.
- Bind the settings client's network policy to the authenticated account and select authentication through the runtime-aware backend client.
- Stop policy resolution after an unsuccessful settings lookup or timeout instead of restarting it when credentials changed during recovery.

## Testing

Add app-server coverage for `dual_header` and `assertion_only` authentication with default and custom destinations, including attribution instructions in model input. Add a regression test verifying that repeated `401` responses trigger only one credential refresh and omit attribution instructions.

prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix MCP startup tracking when attaching to shared app servers

## Why

Clients attaching to a shared app server can miss startup notifications and have a different local MCP configuration. Waiting for locally configured servers can leave the TUI stuck in a busy state.

## What changed

- Track only reported MCP servers for shared app servers and subagents, settling startup once observed starts complete.
- Handle standalone terminal updates without reopening startup, while reporting failures and cancellations even when their starts were missed.
- Suppress duplicate diagnostics until an observed retry or notification lag, and include all received outcomes in each active round's summary.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for attachment before, during, and after startup; idle keyboard behavior after startup settles; terminal-only failures and cancellations; and repeated failures after retries or notification lag.
